stimulus.alt: Diagram of a cultivation facility showing movement between a cleaner sensitive zone, a controlled transition boundary, and a higher-risk or unresolved zone, with people, tools, carts, hose ends, plants, and debris as possible contamination pathways.
stimulus.caption: Use the pathway map to reason about what must happen before shared equipment crosses into a cleaner or more sensitive zone.

stem: A cart has just been used in quarantine and is urgently needed in propagation. What is the best response?
choices: Complete the approved cleaning, disinfection, and release workflow before moving it into the cleaner zone
Wipe only the visibly dirty area and move it
Move it immediately because no sick plants touched the cart
Spray any available disinfectant without cleaning first
rationale: Shared equipment can carry contamination between zones. Movement should follow the approved sanitation and release process rather than urgency or visible cleanliness alone.
